what: Every published route's place in the codex: volume, part, archetype, spread and neighbours. The shared shell reads its state from here rather than guessing from DOM shape, which is the brief's §14.3.

refuses.inventing a volume for an unplaced route: the tool exits non-zero instead, so 'every route is placed' is a checkable fact and not a sentence somebody wrote.
refuses.prev/next across the entity records: alphabetical adjacency is not a reading sequence; an arrow promising one would lie.

divergence_from_the_brief.annals.html: the brief places archive annals in Volume II; the owner moved it to Encyclopedia on 30 July because its subject is the ARCHIVE and not Arda. The owner's ruling wins and the divergence is recorded.
divergence_from_the_brief.living.html: the halls put it under Peoples; the brief's Volume IV contents list puts a herbarium with relics and devices. The brief is followed.

volumes.name: Living World, Relics and Devices
volumes.thesis: what was made and what grows

codex-proto.html.title: The Specimen Sheet
codex-proto.html.note: C73: this is the specimen sheet every other page in the archive is scored against, not a hall of the archive. It is published so a reader can see what the halls are measured by. It is never edited.
